what: Simulate a small dataset with known answers
title: Get started with spatialDWLS
text: able check result, simulate spots whose true composition known. Eight cell types get 40 marker genes; spot holds 2 10 cells drawn one six tissue niches; niche spot’s cluster.
code: set.seed(1) n_genes <- 1500; n_types <- 8; n_spots <- 400 types <- paste0("type", seq_len(n_types))  # expression profile of each cell type profile <- matrix(rlnorm(n_genes), n_genes, n_types,                   dimnames = list(paste0("g", seq_len(n_genes)), types)) markers <- split(sample(n_genes, 40 * n_types), rep(types, each = 40)) for (ct in types) {   profile[markers[[ct]], ct] <- profile[markers[[ct]], ct] * runif(40, 4, 10) } profile <- sweep(profile, 2, colSums(profile), "/") * 5000  normalise <- function(counts) {   counts <- Matrix(counts, sparse = TRUE)   t(t(counts) / pmax(colSums(counts), 1)) * 1e4 }  # a single-cell reference: 60 cells per type ref_type <- rep(types, each = 60) ref <- matrix(rpois(n_genes * length(ref_type), profile[, ref_type] * 0.3),               n_genes, dimnames = list(rownames(profile), NULL))  # spots: each niche favours a few cell types niche_mix <- t(replicate(6, { p <- rgamma(n_types, 0.3); p / sum(p) })) niche <- sample(6, n_spots, replace = TRUE) cells <- sample(2:10, n_spots, replace = TRUE) composition <- sapply(seq_len(n_spots), function(s) {   rmultinom(1, cells[s], niche_mix[niche[s], ]) }) spot_counts <- matrix(rpois(n_genes * n_spots, profile %*% composition * 0.5),                       n_genes, dimnames = list(rownames(profile),                                                paste0("spot", seq_len(n_spots)))) truth <- sweep(composition, 2, cells, "/") dimnames(truth) <- list(types, colnames(spot_counts))

title: Get started with spatialDWLS
text: dwls_signature() averages cell type signature features. Pass reference normalised, logged scale: scale spots solved .
code: signature <- dwls_signature(normalise(ref),                             sign_gene = rownames(profile)[unlist(markers)],                             cell_type = ref_type) dim(signature) #> [1] 320   8 round(signature[1:4, 1:4], 1) #>     type1 type2 type3 type4 #> g12   4.7   4.6  28.5   5.2 #> g15  10.7   9.3  10.4  11.5 #> g17   2.8   3.5  15.2   3.4 #> g27   2.7   1.7   2.7  18.3

title: Get started with spatialDWLS
text: parallel. Pass BiocParallel param. result identical serial run. spots memory. dwls_stream() asks expression one window spots time, function supply, signature features. windows just column blocks matrix, read_window equally read disk.
code: prop <- dwls(spot_expr, signature, clusters, n_cell = 10,              BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(8)) windows <- split(colnames(spot_expr), ceiling(seq_len(n_spots) / 100)) read_window <- function(i, features) spot_expr[features, windows[[i]]]  prop_streamed <- dwls_stream(   read_window = read_window,   n_windows = length(windows),   feat_ids = rownames(spot_expr),   clusters = setNames(clusters, colnames(spot_expr)),   sign_matrix = signature,   n_cell = 10 ) all.equal(prop_streamed, prop) #> [1] TRUE

code: set.seed(1) genes <- paste0("g", 1:30) sig <- matrix(1, 30, 3, dimnames = list(genes, c("A", "B", "C"))) sig[1:10, "A"] <- sig[11:20, "B"] <- sig[21:30, "C"] <- 40  # 20 spots mixing A and B, 20 spots of C alone mix <- cbind(rbind(a <- runif(20, 0.3, 0.7), 1 - a, 0),              matrix(c(0, 0, 1), 3, 20)) counts <- matrix(rpois(30 * 40, sig %*% mix * 5), 30,                  dimnames = list(genes, paste0("s", 1:40))) clusters <- rep(c("mixed", "pure"), each = 20)  prop <- dwls(log2(counts + 1), sig, clusters, n_cell = 5) round(prop[, c(1:3, 21:23)], 2) #>     s1   s2   s3 s21 s22 s23 #> A 0.42 0.44 0.52   0   0   0 #> B 0.58 0.56 0.48   0   0   0 #> C 0.00 0.00 0.00   1   1   1

code: set.seed(1) genes <- paste0("g", 1:30) sig <- matrix(1, 30, 3, dimnames = list(genes, c("A", "B", "C"))) sig[1:10, "A"] <- sig[11:20, "B"] <- sig[21:30, "C"] <- 40 mix <- cbind(rbind(a <- runif(20, 0.3, 0.7), 1 - a, 0),              matrix(c(0, 0, 1), 3, 20)) expr <- log2(matrix(rpois(30 * 40, sig %*% mix * 5), 30,                     dimnames = list(genes, paste0("s", 1:40))) + 1) clusters <- setNames(rep(c("mixed", "pure"), each = 20), colnames(expr))  # read the spots ten at a time windows <- split(colnames(expr), rep(1:4, each = 10)) prop <- dwls_stream(     read_window = function(i, features) expr[features, windows[[i]]],     n_windows = length(windows), feat_ids = rownames(expr),     clusters = clusters, sign_matrix = sig, n_cell = 5 ) all.equal(prop, dwls(expr, sig, clusters, n_cell = 5)) #> [1] TRUE

title: spatialDWLS 0.1.0
text: First release standalone package. algorithm previously runDWLSDeconv() inside Giotto (<= 4.3.1), now calls package. Results match Giotto 4.3.1 floating point (~1e-15), except bugs fixed: Clusters single candidate cell type spot round now assign type proportion 1; left 0. Small negative values constrained solver now clipped 0 every cell type, last one. Running DWLS longer leaves session’s random number generator fixed state. Faster (12-22x serial 600-20,000 spots): dampening constant’s cross-validation uses .lm.fit() k x k weighted least squares instead lm(), draws 100 subsets . Weighted solves use crossprod(S * w, S) instead features x features diag(w), call Matrix::nearPD() matrix needs . reverse-log transform keeps sparse input sparse touches signature features. New: BPPARAM parallel per-cluster plans per-spot solves. dwls_stream() expression read windows. na_as_zero. dwls_signature(), matrix form Giotto’s makeSignMatrixDWLSfromMatrix().
